dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きてますか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you awake, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Are you awake, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 扉が開いて紙袋を持った音夢が姿を見せる。
dialogues.en: The door opened and Nemu came inside holding a paper bag.
dialogues.text: The door opened and Nemu came inside holding a paper bag.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 顔だけ音夢に向け答える。
dialogues.en:
I looked at Nemu and answered. I've been lying on the bed
for a long time, and I'm not even sleepy.
dialogues.text:
I looked at Nemu and answered. I've been lying on the bed
for a long time, and I'm not even sleepy.

dialogues.jp:
ずっとベッドに横になってるもんだから、眠気
なんて溜まりやしない。
dialogues.en:
I used to think that I wanted to sleep all day, but it isn't
a pleasant thing, being unable to move at all.
dialogues.text:
I used to think that I wanted to sleep all day, but it isn't
a pleasant thing, being unable to move at all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「身体の調子はどう？」
dialogues.en: "How do you feel?"
dialogues.text: "How do you feel?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「昨日の今日でそんなに変わんないって」
dialogues.en: "I'm not much different from yesterday."
dialogues.text: "I'm not much different from yesterday."

dialogues.jp:
持ってきた荷物をベッドの脇に置いて、音夢が
椅子に腰掛ける。
dialogues.en: She placed the bag by the bed, and sat on the chair.
dialogues.text: She placed the bag by the bed, and sat on the chair.

dialogues.jp: 「それにしても早いな。まだ余裕で午前中だぞ」
dialogues.en: "You got here early. It's not even noon yet."
dialogues.text: "You got here early. It's not even noon yet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。早めに持ってきておいた方がいいかな、
　と思って。兄さんもいろいろと不便だろうし」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I thought I should bring these to you early, so it
wouldn't be an inconvenience to you."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I thought I should bring these to you early, so it
wouldn't be an inconvenience to you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「すまないねぇ……わしの身体がこんなんばっ
　かりに、お前にはすっかり苦労させちまって
　……げほげほ」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you, dear...... I'm causing you so much trouble
because of my old body......"
dialogues.text:
"Thank you, dear...... I'm causing you so much trouble
because of my old body......"

dialogues.jp: 照れ隠しに、お約束なギャグをかましてみる。
dialogues.en: I made a joke in order to hide my embarrassment.
dialogues.text: I made a joke in order to hide my embarrassment.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、早くよくなってくださいね、おじ
　いさん」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, grandpa, please get well soon."
dialogues.text: "It's okay, grandpa, please get well soon."

dialogues.jp:
持ってきた服と洗濯物を詰め替えながら、軽く
流される。
dialogues.en:
She replied jokingly while unpacking the clothes she brought
for me.
dialogues.text:
She replied jokingly while unpacking the clothes she brought
for me.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても何で個室なんだ？　他に病室が
　空いてなかったのか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, why did I get a private room? Were the other
rooms all full?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, why did I get a private room? Were the other
rooms all full?"

dialogues.jp:
ただの骨折では、普通、６人ぐらい一緒の部屋
だと思うんだけど。
dialogues.en:
I only have a small fracture. Typically, patients like me
share a room with other people.
dialogues.text:
I only have a small fracture. Typically, patients like me
share a room with other people.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。そんなことないよ」
dialogues.en: "No, there are some empty beds in the other rooms."
dialogues.text: "No, there are some empty beds in the other rooms."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Then how come I got this room?"
dialogues.text: "Then how come I got this room?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんが助けた先輩の人のお父さんが、ここ
　の院長さんなんだって。だから特別に個室に
　入れてくれたの」
dialogues.en:
"The father of the girl you saved is the director of this
hospital. That's why you got a private room."
dialogues.text:
"The father of the girl you saved is the director of this
hospital. That's why you got a private room."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ！？　萌先輩の父親がここの院長？」
dialogues.en:
"What? Moe-sempai's father is the director of this
hospital?"
dialogues.text:
"What? Moe-sempai's father is the director of this
hospital?"

dialogues.jp: し、知らんかった……。
dialogues.en: I didn't know that......
dialogues.text: I didn't know that......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、ホントよかったじゃない、休み中で。
　試験前とかだったら、悲惨だったよ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'm glad this happened during the spring break. It
would've been a disaster if this occurred before the exam
week."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'm glad this happened during the spring break. It
would've been a disaster if this occurred before the exam
week."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「よくない！　俺のバカンスが台無しだ！」
dialogues.en: "It's not good!! My vacation's ruined!!"
dialogues.text: "It's not good!! My vacation's ruined!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、しっかり養生して、早く退院してくだ
　さいね」
dialogues.en: "Well, just relax and get out of here as soon as possible."
dialogues.text: "Well, just relax and get out of here as soon as possible."

dialogues.jp: 花の包みを｛ほど／解｝きながら、音夢が微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled while unraveling the paper around the flowers.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled while unraveling the paper around the flowers.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……で、いつ退院できそうだって？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... so when did they say I could leave here?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... so when did they say I could leave here?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うーん、３〜４週間だって」
dialogues.en: "They said it's going to take about 3 to 4 weeks."
dialogues.text: "They said it's going to take about 3 to 4 weeks."

dialogues.jp: バカンスは今、終わった……。
dialogues.en: My vacation has officially ended......
dialogues.text: My vacation has officially ended......

dialogues.jp:
「本校の入学式に間に合わなかったら、俺の紹
　介もしておいてくれ」
dialogues.en:
"If I don't make it to the entrance ceremony on time, please
introduce me to everyone."
dialogues.text:
"If I don't make it to the entrance ceremony on time, please
introduce me to everyone."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 予想外の音夢の反応に顔を見返す。
dialogues.en: I looked back at Nemu as she reacted strangely to my words.
dialogues.text: I looked back at Nemu as she reacted strangely to my words.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
てっきり、ツッコミが入ると思っていたのに、
なぜか驚き顔の音夢。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, her reaction was accompanied with a
surprised look on her face.
dialogues.text:
For some reason, her reaction was accompanied with a
surprised look on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……なんでもない……」
dialogues.en: "No...... It's nothing......"
dialogues.text: "No...... It's nothing......"

dialogues.jp: 慌てて否定する姿が、すでに不審極まりない。
dialogues.en:
She quickly tried to deny it, but it made her look more
suspicious.
dialogues.text:
She quickly tried to deny it, but it made her look more
suspicious.

dialogues.jp: 「自分の料理でも食べたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you eat your homecooked meal or something?"
dialogues.text: "Did you eat your homecooked meal or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どういう意味ですか、それは……」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: ぷるぷると拳が震えている。
dialogues.en: She showed me her shaking fist.
dialogues.text: She showed me her shaking fist.

dialogues.jp: 「一応言っておくが、俺はケガ人だぞ」
dialogues.en: "Just to let you know, I'm a patient here."
dialogues.text: "Just to let you know, I'm a patient here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、まな板の鯉ですよね。さて、どう料理
　しようかな♪」
dialogues.en:
"Right. You're a carp on the cutting board. How should I
cook you......?"
dialogues.text:
"Right. You're a carp on the cutting board. How should I
cook you......?"

dialogues.jp: いま、真の恐怖というものを教わった気がする。
dialogues.en: I just learned what true horror means......
dialogues.text: I just learned what true horror means......

dialogues.jp: 「冗談さておき、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Okay, enough with the jokes, what's wrong with you?"
dialogues.text: "Okay, enough with the jokes, what's wrong with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうもしません。兄さんは人の心配なんかし
　ないでケガを治すことだけ考えてればいいの」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing's wrong. You don't have to worry about anyone else.
I just want you to concentrate on healing yourself, okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Nothing's wrong. You don't have to worry about anyone else.
I just want you to concentrate on healing yourself, okay?"

dialogues.jp:
ほんのわずかだが俺から視線を外し、椅子から
立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
She slightly looked away from me and stood up from the
chair.
dialogues.text:
She slightly looked away from me and stood up from the
chair.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「花瓶に水いれて来るね」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to get some water for this vase."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to get some water for this vase."

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、逃げるようにして病室を出て行って
しまった。
dialogues.en:
She left the room as if she was escaping the uneasy
situation.
dialogues.text:
She left the room as if she was escaping the uneasy
situation.

dialogues.jp:
なにを無理しているのかは知らんが、こりゃ早
くケガを治さないと、聞き出せそうもないな。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what she's trying to hide from me, but I must
recover first before I'm able to ask what's wrong.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what she's trying to hide from me, but I must
recover first before I'm able to ask what's wrong.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく、お互いに世話の焼ける兄妹だ……」
dialogues.en: "What siblings! We're both making each other worried......"
dialogues.text: "What siblings! We're both making each other worried......"

dialogues.jp:
寝返りをうてない俺は、布団を目深に被ると、
死んだフリをするのだった……。
dialogues.en:
Not being able to turn over, I covered my face with a
blanket and pretended I was dead......
dialogues.text:
Not being able to turn over, I covered my face with a
blanket and pretended I was dead......

dialogues.jp: ◆不審な音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Strange Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Strange Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢が様子を見に来てくれた。俺は退院するま
で３〜４週間かかるらしい。バカンスの終わり
……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu returned to check on me. She told me that I have to
stay in the hospital for 3 to 4 weeks. My vacation has
officially ended......
dialogues.text:
Nemu returned to check on me. She told me that I have to
stay in the hospital for 3 to 4 weeks. My vacation has
officially ended......

dialogues.jp:
途中、入学式の事に触れると、音夢が妙な反応
を示した。何だろうな……？
dialogues.en:
When I asked her about the entrance ceremony, Nemu reacted
with a strange look. What's wrong with her......?
dialogues.text:
When I asked her about the entrance ceremony, Nemu reacted
with a strange look. What's wrong with her......?
